description: Use this when the user asks whether one specific date is a working day, a public holiday, or whether businesses and banks are open. Names the holiday if there is one, and reports whether independent holiday sources agree on that date.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example AU, US, GB.

date.description: The date to check, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

region.description: Optional ISO 3166-2 subdivision code such as AU-NSW or US-CA.

name: check_business_day
title: Check whether a date is a business day
